title: PWR-A plate-bonded power board, two-sided SHRINK-2 layout - placement draft
note: W2 PCB-PWRA-3: generated by build/kicad/boards/PWR_A/make_spec.py from PWR_A.spec-draft.json, the graph, pcb/partition-spec.json candidates.shrink2 and the MECH-7 contract (never hand-edited). Kept in build/kicad/boards/PWR_A/, not in pcb/boards/: a placement draft with locked power-stage copper; the board of record (routed to DRC 0, fab set) is W2 PCB-PWRA-4. placement_study.py --spec PWR_A.spec-shrink2.json writes placement-study-shrink2.json.

layers.source: build/15 'Шари' and 'Мідь і струмові класи (W2 PCB-RULES)': JLC04161H-7628, 1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner, no 2 oz

plan.F.Cu: L1: parts, signals; BATT/PWR3A pours (scripted where both ends are anchored)
plan.In1.Cu: L2: solid GND (post-route pour over the whole outline)
plan.In2.Cu: L3: GND fill (pre-route plane) until the placement-dependent power pours take their areas (higher priority)
plan.B.Cu: L4: signals; BATT/PWR3A pours paired with L1; GND bond copper in the four thermal_bond zones, solder mask on

layers.types_why: layer type power on both inner layers and a pre-route GND plane on each (as PWR_B): the DSN then carries the planes and Freerouting puts only vias through them. Probe 2 (sr-rx-pcb run 42424071774) and probe 3 (run 42424538187, layer type alone) routed LAB5, E1_N, E1_SHUNT_P and E1_LAB5_FUSED tracks on In1/In2, which the classes do not count (17 check_boards class_widths findings) and which cut the L2 GND plane. L3 power pours (layer plan) go in later as higher-priority zones inside the L3 GND fill

rules_note: board_gen refuses rules_file until it copies and hashes it (PCB-FAB/PCB-SB1 lineage), so the net classes and project rules of pcb/rules/jlc-4l-1oz.kicad_dru and pcb/generated/netclasses.json are mirrored in PWR_A.kicad_pro: classes SIG (Default) 0.15, PWR1A 0.35, PWR2A 0.8, PWR3A 1.85, BATT 3.2 mm outer, clearance 0.15; via 0.6/0.3; min through hole 0.2 because the KiCad LT3045 footprint MSOP-12-1EP ThermalVias drills 0.2 mm (JLC 4-layer floor 0.15)

warning_checks.tuning_profile_track_geometries: no length-tuned nets and no tuning profiles on this board

reserved_area_mm2.what: rule H-TRIM (pcb/partition-spec.json keepouts.h_trim): the area under the PWR-B THT pin fields is a height zone (parts up to zone_h_max_mm), not a keepout

planned_status_source: pcb/partition_budget.py Evaluator.planned on the graph of now (live; pcb/partition-budget.json is regenerated by the AREA lineage)

two_sided.bottom_pockets_source: mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json PWR bottom_side keep_in_mm (MECH-7, plate pockets PB1-PB13, board mm)
two_sided.rule: two-sided PWR-A (SHRINK-2 decision (6), W2 AREA-2 / MECH-7): the chip R/C listed in pcb/partition-budget.json candidates.<chosen>.pwr_a_bottom go on the bottom side; every bottom courtyard lies inside one plate pocket PB* (mechanical.json plate.pwr_bottom_pockets, computed by srrx_mech.rules.pwr_bottom_regions; board-coordinate list in mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json PWR bottom_side.keep_in_mm), so it is outside every thermal_bond zone and its land, outside the converter heat corridors and outside the plate-hole lands; it also stays outside every top THT pin field + 1.0 mm (pcb/partition-spec.json keepouts.pwr_a_bottom_parts); its height is at most the room h_max = shim gap + pocket depth - polyimide film - clearance (R-PWR-BOTTOM)

ffc.rule: the S02 FFC counts as adopted when a PWR-A graph part has a Connector_FFC-FPC footprint (GR-5B); then J113/J114/J115/J507 take the decision places on the bottom edge and exit_edges says so

bottom_row.rule: MECH-7 contract edge_zones[0] row_end_max: the courtyards of J105-J112 + window_margin end at x <= row_end_max, so that the PWR-A bottom edge under the PWR-B PH 9-pin span (PWR_B edge_zones[2]) stays free of PWR-A headers

power_stages.note: W2 PCB-PWRA-3 (design choice; review fixes F1/F2): anchored power stages and their scripted copper. Scripted: E1_SW from J107.2 to Q102; E1_CONV_IN from Q102 to both LM61460 VIN pins (each side with its CIN_HF and CIN, joined by the In2 VIN strap), C107 and both TPSM63606 VIN pins; SYS12 from L102.2 over COUT across the spine to the SYS12 node with F201.1, L202.1 and Q201.2; E1_LAB5_RAW from U108 VOUT to F102.1; E1_LAB5_FUSED from F102.2 to C111.1 and L101.1; LAB5 from L101.2 to C112.1, F104.1, L205.1 (the LT3045 feed) and the four J208 LAB5 contacts (F.Cu and B.Cu trunk). Left to the router (PCB-PWRA-4; placement_study.py corridor pre-check): the U107/U108 small-signal pins (FB, RT, EN, CBOOT, RBOOT, VCC, BIAS, PG) to their parts, the 0603 E1_CONV_IN bypass C132 at U108, the other LAB5 loads (J104, J206.2, U503, U553, C552, C509, C223, R110), E2_LNA_IN from L205.2 to the LT3045 IN pins and every branch net after F201, L202 and Q201

small_signal.rule: W2 PWR-L6-PLACE (placement only): the U107 and U108 small-signal parts anchored inside thermal_bond zones 3'/4' next to their pins (make_spec.py SMALL_SIGNAL_ANCHORS); MODEL geometry, pad centre to pin centre: CVCC <= 2.0 mm of VCC/AGND, CBOOT, RBOOT and the feedback parts <= 5.0 mm of their pins (project limits). Their copper (the SW-CBOOT link through the VIN2-RBOOT gap, the FB node on F.Cu only, AGND to PGND under U108) is W2 PWR-L6-SCRIPT's; the F.Cu VIN2 bar CONVIN-U107-L-BAR closes that gap today
small_signal.source: TI LM61460 SNVSBD5D (rev. D, July 2022) section 11.1 and figure 11-2 Layout Example, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/lm61460.pdf, and TI TPSM63606 SLVSGB4B (rev. B, April 2022) section 11.1, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tpsm63606.pdf, both read 2026-11-13 (curl default User-Agent, HTTP 200, sha256 2c8a0bf340c70aa3ac29e586146804d7651822e14bee0897f6415ee9e56be84d and d1c157ff51c0e24bec9749dc434c3f8cdb8e980a7d1295d3a51c7d13f8ab4147; fetch-only, not committed); the 2 mm and 5 mm limits are project rules for TI's "as close as possible", not TI numbers
